history.value: A fine-tune burst of under about 100 games on one mechanic sets replay share 0.9 in its config: 33 games at 0.9 cut half or more of the cost on four generated mechanics of two trigger kinds (measurement/share-curve@retention, measurement/share-quote-widen@sentries), the trained parent spared on three of them and +1.68 HP per fight on OppCard-PlainDamage x Sentries, so a burst reads its parent row before it ships; on cards it spares the parent but keeps under half of a recurring tick's gain (measurement/card-burst-share@stage-a). A pack chain (one joint burst over a pack's mechanics) trains 99 games per mechanic at share 0.9 (arm g99-sh9): 33 games each were too few for eight mechanics (measurement/pack-dose-33@gen-b1), and g99-sh9 removes g99-at-0.5's TurnEnd-Frail x Lagavulin leak, keeps Nob's cut and the Sentries edge, spares the parents, and fails the per-net guard on one seed of two as g99 at 0.5 did, by less (measurement/pack-dose-99s9@gen-b1); the chain ships only a net that passes the guard. scripts/finetune.py's default stays 0.5 until a lane that edits it changes the default and gives old configs an explicit 0.5.
